rules.name: Support Team
rules.description: A Scorpio Team consists of two Legionaries and a Scorpion. The unit may only perform a Move or Shoot action if it first performs a Special action. A Shoot action may only be performed if at least one Legionary is in contact with the Scorpio.

rules.name: Scorpio
rules.description:
When performing a Shoot action, a Scorpio has the following profile: Range: 40", Special Rules: Lethal 3, Smasher. 
A Scorpio can remove more than one model with a single hit (due to its Lethal rule) in the same way as a Hero.

rules.name: Medicus Support
rules.description:
Even if a Caesar’s Legions warband does not have a medicus travelling with it, it is very likely
to have medical support close by. A warband of Caesar’s Legions is always counted as having
access to the Healing Hands Talent (see page 47) even if no Hero possesses it.
